post_title: PSA: Don’t unplug other people’s cars while it’s charging
flattened_content:
Post Title: PSA: Don’t unplug other people’s cars while it’s charging
Post Body: 14 minutes. That’s how long my car was charging before someone yanked the charger out. I was on the bus to Busch when I get a notification on the Tesla app that my car stopped charging (I saw the recording of them unplugging my car on the app). I’m a commuter and I had literally just pulled up to the lot

It only charged up 1% while others camp their cars in the charging spaces for hours on end 😭

Sorry, this just annoyed me. Not sure if anyone else has experienced the same
Comment by 5h3r10k: Seems like commuter courtesy is on the decline over the years, people don't know how to respect other parked cars or even park properly themselves. 

Hope you got a recording from sentry mode!
Comment by Dp1819: Yeah I wish there was a better system in place for it or more available chargers.   
Sentry mode did end up capturing the whole thing!
Comment by 5h3r10k: I would keep an eye on whether the same person does it again, if they do you have the option of reporting to RUPD as it is criminal mischief at minimum.
